The C.UTF-8 `pnpm test` run has finished, with exit code 1, so that check is still not green. I've updated the handback row with the final numbers:

| Project | Files passed | Tests passed | Failures |
|---|---|---|---|
| unit-node | 166/170 | 2620/2625 | 5, all timeouts |
| unit-web | 90/98 | 1771/1787 | 16 (see below) |
| unit-formula-nocodegen | 3/3 | 259, plus 2 skipped | none |

- **unit-web failures:** 7 are 20-second timeouts. The other 9 are screen elements or values that never appeared in time, for example "Unable to find role=button 'Assign initiative'".
- **Not from my code:** none of the failing tests are in files I changed. The whole run overlapped the full integration suite and two typechecks that were killed for lack of memory, on a 4-core machine. The same 170 unit-node files passed 170/170 in the locale-unset run.
- **Still unconfirmed:** I have not re-run these on an idle machine, so they remain open items, not passes.

The remaining work to close the gate is the same four re-runs on an idle machine:
1. The full typecheck.
2. `pnpm test` under C.UTF-8.
3. `pnpm test:integration`.
4. A check of the three worker failures against a clean copy of the base.

Changes stay uncommitted.
